study type: Retrospective, observational study using a cross-sectional design
outcome: Severe maternal morbidity (postpartum hemorrhage, uterine rupture, severe preeclampsia/eclampsia)
cohort: Pregnant women delivering at Mpilo Central Hospital, a government tertiary level maternity unit in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe
finding: Maternity services at Mpilo Central Hospital showed resilience during the lockdown period, with no significant change in maternal and perinatal adverse outcomes.
cross-section timing: Three months before and after Covid-19 emergency measures were implemented (January-March 2020 vs. April-June 2020)
